column1: # Black/Matrix AD — Chapter 1 recovery scene: Michette

column2: Just because you're awake, don't move yet—!
You've been asleep all this time! Your whole body'll go crack-crack if you push it, y'know?!
So just relax and stay in bed!
I'll tell you a story... so you don't get bored!
It was the day of that great $$落雷$$...
Oh, but... you don't remember, do you?!
You went into the mountains alone to gather $$薬草$$ because I had a $$風邪$$...!
Why didn't you take me to a $$医者$$, you ask...?
W-Well...
Wh-Who cares about that?!
There were circumstances, okay?! There, end of explanation!!
Anyway, putting that aside...
You went deep into the mountains, and it seems you got caught up in some kind of $$事故$$...!
I think it was... a really huge $$事故$$...
(Because... 　I saw it myself...)
(The day the rain finally stopped...)
(When I could finally move again 　and went into the mountains...)
(I found all those $$兵士達$$' $$死体$$, 　lying in a ring around you...!!)
When I saw you barely breathing, $$血だらけ$$...
For a moment, my mind went completely blank...
(Because, out of all my many friends, you were the only one who could actually talk with me...)
*sniff*...
H-Huh...? What was I talking about again...?
Wait—did you... Did you hear all that...?
Aah! Aah! Forget it! Forget it!!
Forget every last thing I just said!!
Oh, right—you already have $$記憶喪失$$... Ahahahahahahaha... ha...
Well then! Bye-bye!!
